learning_outcomes.text: Understand the electrical characteristics of logic families.
Understand sequential logic, asynchronous and synchronous logic circuits, registers, counters and timers, programmable logic circuits.
Understand the structure and operation of microcomputer, microprocessor, registers, memory, number representation in microprocessor systems, coding.

syllabus_topics: Electrical characteristics of logic families. Combinational logic.
Sequential logic, asynchronous and synchronous logic circuits, registers, counters and timers, programmable logic circuits.
Structure and operation of microcomputer, microprocessor, registers, memory, number representation in microprocessor systems, coding.
I/O circuits of microcomputer, voltage and current signal matching, overvoltage protection, galvanic separation, electromagnetic compatibility
D/A and A/D converters. Current loop. Lines of communications (RS232, RS484, RS422, CAN) and protocols, IrDA signal transmission.
Electronic and optoelectronic parts for microelectronics.
Combinational logic and sequential circuit, programmable logic circuits.
Power outputs of logic circuits. Optical separation, relay, SSR.
Input and output of analog signal in microcomputer systems: A-D and D-A converters.
Programmable relay, PLD Easy relay, Siemens LOGO.
Level conversion, comparator, signal shaping, timer.
Measuring central on base of PC-lab card LabView
